title: Decide whether an interface is functional

cases.says: The page's Transformer, with one abstract method and a default andThen, is functional; an interface with two abstract methods is not.
A Validator that also redeclares toString() and equals(Object) abstractly is still functional.
An abstract equals(String) is not Object's equals(Object), and clone() is not public in Object: each counts, so neither interface is functional.
An interface with one abstract method and a static factory is functional.
An empty interface extending Transformer is functional, and one that adds a second abstract method is not.
An abstract class with one abstract method is not a functional interface.
